I believed that the giants were challenging me to a duel. But if they had come to me with a gesture of peace, I would have shown them honor and avoided conflict. My actions were not premeditated; they were born out of my desire to protect Asgard and its people. I regret my mistake, and I am willing to make reparations if it will restore the harmony between us.
